name: ctb_init
description: Initial CTB of a battle: base ICV for 31 slots, the opening counters for a normal, preemptive or ambush start, First Strike, Haste, Slow, and the minimum subtracted.

harness.note: the real machine code of the functions, only the RNG function replaced by a script; rngDraws is what the game asked for

notes: in.slots rows are [agi, haste, slow, autoA, inBattle, isAeon]; every slot starts with ctb 0x5a so unwritten slots are visible.

Classes edge_*: slots the function never writes (0x12, 0x13, 0x1c..0x1e) that are in the battle: their counter keeps its value and loses the minimum as a byte (it wraps), or gains one when no written slot is in the battle (minimum -1).
